# R6.4 — site-shell (PR body)

**Manifest ticket 256 · Round 6 · F2-a · USD $0.00 (offline-only)**

## What

The "Instrument — the calibrated readout" design system and static shell
(spec §9.1/§9.2; `docs/design/39_results-site.md`), as `scripts/site/`:

- `assets/tokens.css` — every token role in both first-class themes, the
  8-slot series palette in F2's fixed order, focus ring per tokens.
- `assets/site.css` — type/space scales, card/chip/table specs, all six
  signature elements (needle readout, noise-floor band, disposition
  stamps, receipt rail, calibration block, graph-paper ground).
- `assets/glyphs.svg` + `assets/favicon.svg` — the double-frame glyph and
  the eight disposition symbols (shape + colour + verbatim text, never
  colour-only).
- `hhsite/` — stdlib component layer: `tokparse`, `contrast` (WCAG 2
  formula), `raster` (deterministic `zlib`/`struct` PNG: favicon.png,
  1200×630 og.png — byte-stable over two builds), `components` +
  `pages` (shell, §9.2 URL map, designed absent states).
- `build_mock.py` — the one stdlib command; `internal` and `all-absent`
  profiles; deterministic tree sha256.
- `config/harnesses.json` — two-char monograms + display names,
  admission-record order.
- `fixtures/phase1.json` — labelled `fixture`; internal profile only.
- `tests/test_tokens.py` — 40/40 ratio pairs; `--selftest` = committed
  mutation (m). `tests/test_site.py` — component battery.
- `golden/all-absent.manifest` + `golden/token-ratios.txt` — the golden
  all-absent digest record and the palette/contrast validator record.
